tools.Name: Remote Detonator
tools.Effect: Can be linked to an explosive to trigger a Delayed Explosion remotely. No separate price, Availability or Encumbrance is specified in the Core Rulebook entry.

medicaeEquipement.Name: FZ-392
medicaeEquipement.Effect: +1 Strength Bonus and immunity to Frightened for 1d10 rounds. Injector Rig refill per dose. Mixing chems causes Poisoned (Minor) until both wear off.

medicaeEquipement.Name: SL-203
medicaeEquipement.Effect: +1 Agility Bonus and Perception Bonus; Speed becomes Fast for 1d10 rounds. Injector Rig refill per dose. Mixing chems causes Poisoned (Minor) until both wear off.

medicaeEquipement.Name: SM-163
medicaeEquipement.Effect: Ignore Critical Wounds and Injuries for 1d10 rounds + your Toughness Bonus. Injector Rig refill per dose. Mixing chems causes Poisoned (Minor) until both wear off.

medicaeEquipement.Name: DT-474
medicaeEquipement.Effect: Remove Poisoned and other recent drug effects. Make a Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or become Stunned for 1d10 minutes. Injector Rig refill per dose. Mixing chems causes Poisoned (Minor) until both wear off.
